rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.

events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.

No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

[APPLICABILITY] nltl:ship/sh:or/first alternative: The applicable calculation branch is restricted to nltl:iceClassIaSuper and does not include nltl:iceClassIa, although the requirement applies to both IA Super and IA ships before 1 September 2003. Required change: Change the applicable branch to match either nltl:iceClassIaSuper or nltl:iceClassIa while retaining the pre-1-September-2003 date condition and associated constraints. | [LOGIC] nltl:ship/sh:or/third alternative: The nonapplicable-date alternative contains only a constructionStageDate test and no ice-class restriction, so an IA Super or IA ship dated on or after 2003-09-01 satisfies the sh:or through this alternative and bypasses all required calculation constraints. Required change: Restrict the nonapplicable alternative to the non-IA-Super/non-IA controlled ice classes, or otherwise ensure that IA Super and IA ships on or after 2003-09-01 cannot satisfy the sh:or without the applicable branch.

[APPLICABILITY] nltl:ship / global sh:property for nltl:constructionStageDate: constructionStageDate is globally mandatory for every ship, including non-IA classes whose applicability is already determined by iceClass; this imposes a requirement not stated by clause 3.2.4 and can reject otherwise conforming non-IA ships. Required change: Remove the global minCount 1 requirement for nltl:constructionStageDate and require exactly one xsd:date constructionStageDate only within the IA Super/IA applicability branch that evaluates the pre-1 September 2003 condition.
No concrete blocking defect detected in the current candidate.
